title: ChannelForge EPG Source Configuration
description: Shape contract for epg_sources.json / epg_sources.local.json / epg_sources.example.json (see Read-ChannelForgeEpgSource.ps1). This validates structure only. It does not enforce the URL trust-boundary rules (scheme allowlist, no credentials, no loopback/private/link-local hosts) — those are runtime checks in Test-ChannelForgeSourceUrl.ps1 and must stay there even if this schema is also used in CI.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note used by template/example files. Ignored by Read-ChannelForgeEpgSource.

name.description: Source name. Must be unique within the file.

priority.description: Lower runs first. Read-ChannelForgeEpgSource sorts sources by this value.

url.description: EPG source URL. Treated as a secret outside example/placeholder files (see docs/reference/SECURITY.md); use https://example.invalid/... in any tracked file.

path.description: Local XMLTV file path. Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing epg_sources.json.

format.description: Optional source format. When omitted, Read-ChannelForgeEpgSource defaults it to xmltv.

enabled.description: Whether this source is included in a build.

role.description: How this source is used relative to others, e.g. 'primary', 'fallback', 'provider-fallback'. Intentionally not an enum: this is a structural schema, not a registry of today's role names, and new roles should not require a schema change.
